## AccountMetrics

Decision B2 made concrete: unbounded reporting aggregates live in a query block, NOT on the Account card. Takes `@account` and `@context` (for `getCards` live queries over the account's realm) and renders the metric strip: MRR (active/trial subscriptions, yearly normalized /12), ARR, Outstanding (open invoices), Collected (paid invoices), Overdue count. Live: a new payment or subscription updates the strip without reloads.

```gts
import { AccountMetrics } from '../account-metrics';
<AccountMetrics @account={{@model.account}} @context={{@context}} />
```

Outstanding is balance-aware (line-item totals minus linked payments via `outstandingBalance()` from `../money` — a partial invoice counts only its remainder; degrades to full totals if payments are unloaded). Collected still sums PAID invoices' line items; per-payment collected-by-date needs Payment-level queries, logged for later.

**Non-goals:** cross-account rollups (pipeline value, win rate — dashboard queries those directly), storing any of these numbers on cards (never), cross-currency summation (mixed currencies are excluded per addendum E).
